name: David Gomberg

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Gomberg lists his occupation as small business owner, retired, with 30 years in business.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists degrees from Oregon State University (BS and MA) and an MBA from Willamette.
bio.excerpt: BS (Political Science/Honors) OSU; MA (Political Science/History/Economics) OSU; MBA (Marketing/ Finance) Willamette

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

bio.statement: His statement lists prior governmental experience as state representative and service on the Senior Services Commission, Small Business Advisory Council, Ocean Science Trust and Seismic Safety Commission.
bio.excerpt: State Representative; Senior Services Commission; Small Business Advisory Council; Ocean Science Trust; Seismic Safety Commission

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

bio.statement: His official legislative page lists party and district as Democrat, District 10 - Lincoln and Western Benton & Lane Counties.
bio.excerpt: District 10 - Lincoln and Western Benton & Lane Counties

bio.statement: His official page greeting says he represents the people of the Central Oregon Coast and the communities of the Coastal Range.
bio.excerpt: It is truly an honor to represent the people Central Oregon Coast and the communities of the Coastal Range.

positions.statement: Gomberg says he has secured $100 million in direct state investments for water, sewer, ports, roads and parks in rural communities.
positions.excerpt: I’ve secured $100 million in direct state investments for dozens of water, sewer, ports, roads, and parks that save you money.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: He says he was named a Housing Champion for funding affordable housing and homelessness solutions.
positions.excerpt: I was named a Housing Champion for funding affordable housing and homelessness solutions.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: He says he passed legislation to reduce taxes on small business and create the Office of Small Business Assistance.
positions.excerpt: I passed legislation to reduce taxes on small business, create the Office of Small Business Assistance

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: He says he fought to fully fund Project Independence and introduced legislation to reduce property taxes on retirees.
positions.excerpt: I fought to fully fund Project Independence, introduced legislation to reduce property taxes on retirees

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: He says that as budget committee co-chair he reversed Governor Kate Brown's proposal to cut funding for Veteran Services.
positions.excerpt: As budget committee co-chair, I reversed Governor Kate Brown’s proposal to cut funding for Veteran Services.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: He says he is working to reduce prescription costs and address the health care workforce crisis.
positions.excerpt: I’m working to reduce prescription costs and to address the crisis in Oregon’s health care workforce.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Nov 3 2026 Voters' Pamphlet (edition Book5)

positions.statement: In a July 2026 Portland Tribune report on a transportation workgroup roundtable, Gomberg said he wants a plan close to consensus reached in a bipartisan way.
positions.excerpt: something close to a consensus and to do so in a bipartisan way

gaps: No roll-call votes were listed on his official legislative page, so voting_record is empty.
No endorsements are listed in his pamphlet statement.
He is the only candidate on the House District 10 ballot per the inventory; no opponent material applies.
